notes: Offline catalog assembled from user-supplied English Questlog list responses and Potentials.ods.
Stat values are displayed screenshot values, not unscaled API numbers. No automatic scaling is assumed.
Descriptions preserve source wording; grammar and surprising game effects are not silently corrected.
Icon URLs are derived from source asset paths and were not verified by downloading.
No per-item roll eligibility, probabilities, inventory limits or equipment activation rules are inferred from mainCategory.
Not a live sync. The source game version is unspecified.
